text: The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki went out. <break time="0.8s" /> To explore the big garden. <break time="0.8s" /> It was full of roses. <break time="0.8s" /> Orange trees, bamboo. <break time="0.8s" /> And tall thick grass. <break time="0.8s" /> There he found. <break time="0.8s" /> Darzee the tailorbird and his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Who were sitting by their nest. <break time="0.8s" /> And crying. <break time="0.8s" /> One of our babies. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell out of the nest yesterday. <break time="0.8s" /> And Nag ate him. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> Just then. <break time="0.8s" /> A big black cobra. <break time="0.8s" /> Rose slowly out of the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> It was Nag. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was five feet long. <break time="0.8s" /> From his head to his tail. <break time="0.8s" /> He spread his hood. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had a mark. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a pair of glasses on it. <break time="0.8s" /> Who is Nag, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> I am Nag. <break time="0.8s" /> Look, and be afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki was afraid for a minute. <break time="0.8s" /> But he knew. <break time="0.8s" /> That fighting snakes was a mongooses job. <break time="0.8s" /> While Nag talked to him. <break time="0.8s" /> Nags wife Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Crept up behind Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> In the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind you, Look behind you. <break time="0.8s" /> Sang Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> And Rikki jumped high. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the air. <break time="0.8s" /> He came down. <break time="0.8s" /> On Nagainas back. <break time="0.8s" /> And bit her. <break time="0.8s" /> And both snakes slid away. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the grass.
